slides.headline: *new moon* in *capricorn* at *3:25 pm*. this is the real new year
the moon sits between us and the *sun*
slides.body: its lit side faces away, so you won't see it tonight. a thin crescent shows up low in the west after sunset in a day or two.

slides.headline: start the thing that takes *a year*
slides.body: astrologers read capricorn new moons as slow, serious starts. not a mood board: a plan with a date and a first step.

slides.headline: three signs feel this *new moon* most

rows.label: capricorn
rows.text: **your sign.** a personal reset. pick one goal.

rows.label: libra
rows.text: home and family plans want a fresh start.

rows.label: aries
rows.text: career resets. saturn's in your sign too.

slides.headline: new moon, new deck. there's always an *11:11*.
slides.body: write the plan in one line tonight. mars slows on sunday, so start first.
